subject: french
title: Around the Classroom
welcome_lead: Desks, boards, doors — bigger classroom things.
meta_desc: KS3 French: classroom furniture and large objects.

walkthroughs.body_html: La table = the table. La chaise = the chair. Both are feminine. Sitting at your desk = 'a ma table'.
Le tableau = the board. La porte = the door. La fenetre = the window. Notice le for masculine, la for feminine.
A French schoolbag = un cartable (traditional satchel) or un sac a dos (backpack). Both common.

mcqs.q: Which letter is typically SILENT at the end of French words like 'petit' or 'froid'?
What follows 'si' (if) in a conditional sentence like 'If I were rich, I would travel'?
options: Imperfect tense (Si j'ÉTAIS riche, je voyagerais).
